task: ae.logic gate-level logic simulator: netlist parser, scalar and 64-way packed evaluation, event-driven simulator with delays and glitches, critical path, exhaustive equivalence checker
reasoning_summary: Designed layers so each has an independent oracle: truth-table literals, integer addition for adders, scalar eval for packed eval, levelised eval for the event simulator, and an exhaustive scalar sweep for Equiv. Wrote tests first including a hand-derived glitch trace; all 78 tests passed on the first run. A 21-mutant hand mutation run exposed one real gap (name-matched input mapping tested only with symmetric gates), closed with an asymmetric function.
